timeout.recommendation: 10 minutes is very long; consider reducing or making configurable

retry.recommendation: Add retry for transient git clone failures (network issues)

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Not critical for git clone as it's a local operation

bulkhead.recommendation: Consider limiting concurrent fork operations to prevent resource exhaustion

fallback.behavior: Cleanup on failure: defer cleanupRepository(repo) removes partial state

idempotency.reason: Fork creates DB records first, then clones. Retry would fail on duplicate DB records.

blast_radius.impact: Fork creation fails; user gets 500 error. Cleanup removes partial state.

findings.detail: Uses db.WithTx for the core operation (add repo, recalculate access, auto-watch)

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: none - all operations are local DB

findings.detail: Uses db.WithTx for the core operation (remove repo, recalculate, cleanup watches)

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: none - all operations are local DB

findings.detail: Multi-step operation: DB insert → git clone → sync branches. If clone fails after DB insert, cleanup runs but could leave partial state if cleanup fails.
findings.recommendation: The defer cleanup is good but consider idempotent cleanup or saga pattern

findings.detail: Git clone has 10-minute timeout which is very long for an HTTP request
findings.recommendation: Move to async processing since 202 is already returned

findings.detail: No limit on concurrent fork operations; many simultaneous forks could exhaust disk I/O
findings.recommendation: Add concurrency limiter for fork operations

non_atomic_operations: DB insert + git clone + branch sync - partial failure leaves cleanup to defer
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: High disk I/O from concurrent forks could slow all git operations
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Cleanup on failure removes partial state

rate_limiting.detail: No built-in rate limiting for API endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting especially for fork creation

dead_letter_queues.detail: No async message flows in these endpoints

single_points_of_failure: Database (single instance typical in small deployments)
cascading_failure_paths: Many concurrent fork requests → disk I/O saturation → all git operations slow down
